title: Settlement Agreements Programme Entry Thresholds, Waiting Periods and Offer Limits
content:
# Settlement Agreements — Programme Entry Thresholds and Offer Limits

Before a programme of Ridgeline's Settlement Agreements can be offered on a placed account, four programme figures come into play: the smallest account balance the programme enters at, the waiting period after the placement date, the cooling-off period after an earlier settlement on the same account expired or defaulted, and the number of settlement offers on the account in rolling 12 months at which the programme is no longer offered.

| Figure | Prompt-Pay Discount Settlement | Lump-Sum Settlement | Two-Payment Settlement | Three-Payment Settlement | Six-Payment Settlement | Hardship Settlement |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Entry gate: smallest account balance (USD) | 50.00 | 100.00 | 300.00 | 500.00 | 1500.00 | 250.00 |
| Further entry condition | none | none | none | none | none | a qualifying hardship hold on the account |
| Waiting period after the placement date (calendar days) | 0 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 45 | 0 |
| Re-offer cooling-off period (calendar days) | 0 | 15 | 15 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Offers on the account in rolling 12 months at which the programme is no longer offered | 1 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 2 | 2 |

## What each figure measures

- **Entry gate** — the programme is entered only on an account whose balance is at least the figure shown; the Hardship Settlement additionally needs a qualifying hardship hold on the account.
- **Waiting period** — counted in calendar days from the account's placement date; a period of 0 means the programme may be offered from the placement date onward.
- **Cooling-off period** — counted in calendar days from the closing date of the account's most recent settlement that expired or defaulted, and read from the programme now to be offered.
- **Offer limit** — a count of the settlement offers of any programme on the one account in rolling 12 months; once that count has reached the figure shown, the programme is no longer offered.

## Hypothetical comparison

On a hypothetical account carrying two settlement offers in the past 365 days, the Six-Payment Settlement and the Hardship Settlement (limit 2) are no longer offered, while the Lump-Sum, Two-Payment and Three-Payment Settlements (limit 3) remain open; the Prompt-Pay Discount Settlement (limit 1) closed when the first offer was made.
